title: Lakshya Sen Advances to Japan Masters 2026 Final
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen has reached a significant BWF 500 final, showcasing his top form on the international stage.
summary: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen defeated Indonesia's Alwi Frahan in a thrilling one-hour, nine-minute semifinal match at the Japan Masters 2026, securing his spot in the final where he will face either Koni Watanabe or Kunlavut Vitidsarn.

title: Japan Masters: Lakshya Sen Semifinal Streaming Info
indian_angle: Indian fans needed to know how to watch Lakshya Sen's crucial semifinal match at the Japan Masters 2026.
summary: Details were provided for live streaming and telecast of the Japan Masters 2026 men’s singles semifinal between India's Lakshya Sen and Alwi Farhan, allowing fans to follow the action.

title: Lakshya Sen Enters Kumamoto Masters Semifinals
indian_angle: India's Lakshya Sen continued his strong performance by securing a spot in the semifinals of the Kumamoto Masters Japan.
summary: Eighth seed Lakshya Sen, who recently won the Hylo Open, advanced to the semifinals of the Kumamoto Masters Japan, further improving his BWF World Tour ranking with 64,980 points.
